mods.name: Nourished
mods.description: Nourished is a nutrition mod for NeoForge 1.21.1that tracks 5 food groups, rewards a varied diet, and applies balance buffs and neglect penalties. Includes an on-screen HUD, diet screen, and configurable modules for servers and modpacks. Requires MariesLib beta.

releases.notes:
Major Item Editor expansion, bulk editing, calorie controls, and numerous fixes.

### Highlights

- **A full in-game Item Editor.** Open it from the Food Scanner's edit (?) button or a new hotkey, see exactly why an item got its values, and override them with no reload needed.
- **Bulk editing.** Drag several items in from JEI or EMI and change all of them in one click.
- **Calorie controls.** Turn calories off for a single food, or give it a fixed custom calorie value.
- **Browse and review your edits.** Filter the item list down to what you need, and see every item you've customized in one place.

### Added

**Item Editor**
- Edit (?) button on every Food Scanner row, plus a new hotkey (set it in the Hotkeys config) that opens the editor with nothing selected, ready for an item dragged in from JEI
- **Options** page: Excluded from classification, Calories Off, Silent Eat, Exclude from Recent Meals, Raw Food Tier (Auto/Fine/Mild/Medium/Severe) and Diminishing Returns Off
- **Diminishing Returns (All Food)** toggle on the Options page ? the same switch as the Advanced config setting
- **Calories** page: Calories Off moved here, plus a new "Use Custom Calories" toggle and slider
- **Nutrient Groups** page: a checkbox per nutrient bar, for when you just want an item to count (or not) toward a nutrient
- **Browse Items** page: filter by All, Modified, Unmodified, Missing Nutrition, Excluded, Foods or Items with Recipes, then click an item to edit it
- **Edited Items** page: every item you've customized, tagged with what's set, opening straight to the right page
- **Bulk Edit** page: apply exclusion, calories off, silent eat, recent-meals exclusion, diminishing returns off, or add/remove a nutrient group to many items at once
- **Exclude Tooltip** page: a custom message, color and Pulse animation for the "Excluded from nutrition tracking" tooltip line
- Every page has its own Save/Revert pair in the top-right corner

**Diet Screen**
- The editor now opens on a Home page: your character in 3D next to a live summary of calories, balance, intake and active effects

### Changed

- The Item Editor's Info tab shows a readable, color-coded classification trace with plain-English step names

### Fixed

- The item editor hotkey works while your inventory is open, and opens on top of it so JEI stays available to drag from
- JEI's item list shows up beside the standalone item editor, and dragging items in also works with EMI
- Eating an excluded item no longer still gives you its nutrients
- Items excluded from the Options page now show the "Excluded from nutrition tracking" tooltip instead of "Unclassified"
- "Diminishing Returns Off" now works in packs with more than one MariesLib-based mod, and the tooltip preview matches what eating actually does
- The Browse Items window could save its position off-screen, making the hotkey look broken
- Nutrient HUD: the box grows to fit newly visible or newly added nutrient bars instead of clipping them
- Nutrient HUD: the last bar's percentage no longer gets clipped after moving bars or icons
- A removed compat addon's nutrient bar (e.g. Hydration) no longer lingers on the HUD and Diet Screen

### Removed

- The Padding slider from the Nutrient HUD, Calorie History and Activity Log edit panels ? every box is drag-resizable, and the slider caused the clipping bug above

**Full notes:** <https://marieswiki.kgbcupcake.workers.dev/mods/nourished/changelog/0.2.7-beta.3/>

releases.notes:
# Nourished 0.2.7-beta.2

This is a big UI overhaul. Nearly every box on the HUD and Diet Screen can now be moved, resized, restyled and recolored in-game. The guide book has also moved from Patchouli to Modonomicon.

> **Requires:** Modonomicon, and MariesLib / Marie's Framework **0.1.2-beta** or newer. Patchouli is **no longer needed**.

## ✨ Highlights

- **New guide book (Modonomicon):** chapters for Getting Started, How It Works, Food Safety, Food Groups and Compat Mods. Compat pages only show up for mods you have installed.
- **The Diet Screen is fully customizable.** You can drag, resize and restyle every box: Calories, Balance, Recent Meals, Eat More, Active Effects and each Intake Breakdown row. Text, icons, bars and header can each be moved separately.
- **New editor hub:** the Diet Screen's box settings now live in one resizable window with a sidebar, instead of a stack of tabs.
- **Glow and Pulse:** every box can glow, and its border can "breathe" in its own colors. Pick Smooth, Heartbeat or Flash; all boxes pulse in sync.
- **In-game color editing:** a Colors tab lets you change every HUD and Diet Screen color, and the color picker can save favorite colors.

## ➕ Added

- Style options on every box: background and border opacity and shade, text and border shadow, and border and bar glow
- Resizing a box snaps it to the same size as its neighbours when you're close
- Nutrient HUD:
  - Move Nutrient: drag a nutrient's whole row to rearrange the rows
  - Its own bar glow for each nutrient
  - Hide Bars, Hide Text, Hide Icons and Hide Window
- Header (title) size and Hide Header on every Diet box, including the Diet Screen itself
- Separate Text size, Icon size, Bar size and brightness sliders on every box
- Intake Breakdown rows: bar fill color, icon border color, icon size, and a Move Icon toggle
- Active Effects: icons and +/- markers can be moved, hidden and resized separately from the effect names
- The Nutrient HUD scrolls when it's shorter than its rows
- A single "Reset This Module" button on every box
- "Free Bites Before Diminishing" setting: how many times a food can be eaten at full value
- Activity Log and Calorie History start as tabs on the left in edit mode, the same click-to-open style as the settings windows
- **For addon devs:**
- New `NourishedRegisterEvent` for registering nutrients, foods and effects in one place
  - A full `docs/ADDON_GUIDE.md` with an example addon
  - A "Nourished Test" Command Center tab with Registration Report and Check Held Food
  - KubeJS `registerNutrient` now accepts `icon` and `tags`

## 🔧 Changed

- HUD panels have rounded corners
- Calorie History reads "1 day", "2 days" and so on, and the HUD shows "Veggies"
- Nutrients always draw in their own color (no more threshold tinting)
- Each nutrient's color is now set on its own Intake Breakdown row, instead of in one long list
- The Diet Screen editor panel grows when you drag a box past its bottom, instead of pushing boxes into each other
- Removed options that did nothing: padding sliders, some Move/Hide toggles, and duplicate text colors

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Every item in the game showed a Nourished tooltip.** Fixed.
- **"Today" calories never reset.** They now reset each in-game day, including after sleeping or using `/time`.
- Previewing an effect in the effect editor no longer leaves it stuck on you forever
- The screen flickered or flashed black while eating, and the HUD stuttered
- The game crashed when opening "Edit All" HUD mode
- The guide book couldn't be crafted
- Addon nutrients:
- They didn't get a Diet Screen row
- Their decay and threshold overrides weren't saved
- The Nutrient HUD's edit mode now shows every bar, including hidden ones, and its move outlines match what's on screen
- Activity Log and Calorie History no longer overlap on a fresh install, after a reset, or after dragging
- Bar glow, Hide Icons, Hide Bars and Icon size didn't work on several boxes

mods.description: Nourished is a nutrition mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that tracks six food groups, rewards a varied diet, and applies balance buffs and neglect penalties. Includes an on-screen HUD, diet screen, and configurable modules for servers and modpacks. Requires MariesLib beta.

releases.notes:
> Large release: activity-driven nutrient system (mining/combat/sprint/swim/starvation), a full MarieUI restyle across every HUD panel, food-eaten notifications, and a recipe inheritance fix that should finally resolve the calzone/create food multi-value gap.

## New: Activity-Driven Nutrients

* Added five new independently toggleable activity modules:

  * `SprintDecayModule`
  * `SwimDecayModule`
  * `MiningModule`
  * `CombatModule`
  * `StarvationModule`
* Activity modules are dispatched through `ActivityModuleDispatcher` / `ActivityModuleRegistry`.
* Each module has:

  * Its own config category
  * Independent enable/disable control
  * Per-module HUD log colors
* Added a new **draggable/resizable Activity Log HUD** panel.

  * Default keybind: `K`
  * Displays recent activity effects
  * Backed by a client-side ring buffer
* Activity-driven nutrient configuration was migrated from TOML to a JSON registry via `ActivityDrivenNutrientRegistry`.
* Configuration is synchronized using MarieLib's generic `MarieResourcesAPI` "
* Added five new daily trackers:

  * `nourished:activity/mining_blocks`
  * `nourished:activity/combat_kills`
  * `nourished:activity/starvation_crossings`
  * `nourished:activity/sprint_distance`
  * `nourished:activity/swim_distance`
* Sprint and swim tracking now measure **actual blocks moved** using a new per-tick position-delta tracker with teleport/discontinuity guarding instead of simply counting active ticks.
* All five activity trackers are wired into MarieLib's new tracker-milestone system.
* Added KubeJS support through `NourishedAPI.registerTrackerMilestone`.

## New: Notifications & Command Center

* Eating food that changes calories or nutrients now displays a merged, rate-limited notification above the XP bar.

  * Displays the food name
  * Displays the calorie delta
* Per-nutrient notification lines were tested and removed for simplicity.
* Reworked the **Command Center** into a command launcher only.
* Added **Nourished Tools** commands:

  * Export All
  * Audit Tags
  * Debug Activity Log
  * Reload
  * Invalidate Cache
  * Unassigned Sources
  * NBT Paths
  * List Profile
  * Get Profile
* Added **framework** commands:

  * Status
  * Mods
  * API
  * Registries
* Commands dispatch real network commands through the new `dispatchCommand` helper.
* Removed the earlier **Diet Screen** shortcut category once edit-mode access covered that use case.

## New: Unified HUD Editing

* Added a new global **Edit All HUDs** keybind (`EDIT_ALL_HUDS`) through MarieLib's `EditModeCoordinator`.
* One shared edit overlay now controls:

  * Calorie HUD
  * Activity Log HUD
  * Nutrient HUD
* Every HUD panel now uses MarieLib's `ContentScaleController` / `ScaleConfigPanel` pattern:

  * Calorie HUD
  * Activity Log HUD
  * Nutrient HUD
  * Diet Screen's five sub-boxes
* Double-click continues to adjust **text scale**.
* Right-double-click now adjusts an independent **padding** value.
* Each panel automatically displays its own `ScaleConfigPanel "card" while in edit mode.
* Removed the old double-click/scroll interaction and `DietZoomController` in favor of card-only editing.
* All three HUD panels now register with MarieLib's `SnapRegistry`.

* Dragging one panel can snap it to the edges of the others.

## Visual Restyle

* Restyled `CalorieHudScreen` and `ActivityLogHudPanel` to match `ScaleConfigPanel`'s rounded-card design.
* Added:

  * Colored title headers
  * Opacity sliders
  * Shade sliders
  * `MarieColors.withOpacity`
  * `MarieColors.shade`
* Calorie and activity rows now display:

  * Icon
  * Label
  * Colored progress bar
  * Value
* Calorie bars are measured against the daily calorie goal:

  * Green under the goal
  * Red past 100%
* Activity bars are measured against each tracker's **own historical maximum**.

mods.description: Nourished is a nutrition mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that tracks six food groups, rewards a varied diet, and applies balance buffs and neglect penalties. Includes an on-screen HUD, diet screen, and configurable modules for servers and modpacks. Requires MarieLib 0.1.1-beta.4+

releases.notes:
> A lot has changed in this update and some of the changes are breaking. Please read the changelog carefully and check your configs and datapacks for any necessary updates. This also includes MariesLib updates: several packages/classes were renamed or moved (tooltip helpers, override file layout). Please check the MariesLib changelog for details.

### Highlights
- New dynamic, modular UI system for the HUD and Diet Screen:  draggable, resizable, persistent layouts. The classic UI is kept fully intact and toggleable via `hudClassicMode` / `dietScreenClassicMode`, so you're not forced onto the new system.
- `excluded_items.json`: fully exclude specific items from nutrient tracking
- Per-item food overrides now merge with normal classification instead of fully replacing it
- Per-box zoom for Diet Screen left-column boxes

### Breaking
- Config overrides (`food_overrides.json`, `source_classifications.json`, `excluded_items.json`) moved to `config/nourished/overrides/`:  update datapacks/scripts referencing the old path
- Requires MariesLib 0.1.1-beta.4+ (hard dependency)

### Fixed
- Several Diet Screen resize/reflow/zoom bugs (see CHANGELOG.md for full detail)
- `food_overrides.json` overrides now actually apply at runtime (previously not wired into `RuntimeFoodResolver`)
- Duplicate/reopened Diet Screen on repeated keybind press

Full changelog: see CHANGELOG.md

releases.notes:
## [ Nourished 0.2.6-beta.5 ] 2026-6-29

### Added

- **`enableDiminishingReturns` master toggle** for the diminishing-returns system, exposed in the
  Advanced config tab alongside the existing `diminishingFloor`, `diminishingSteepness`, and
  `diminishingMidpoint` sliders. When disabled, `diminishingFloor` and `noveltyBonus` are both
  forced to `1.0` (repeated foods keep full value) on server, client, and client-fallback memory
  configs alike (`NourishedMemoryConfig`).
- Config screen **Save & Save All Files** now reloads and re-broadcasts config to connected
  players when an integrated singleplayer server is running, instead of requiring a manual
  `/nourished reload` or world rejoin to see changes take effect.

### Changed

- **Items with only nutrient-tag data (no vanilla `FoodProperties`) are now recognized as
  nutritious food**: `NourishedItems.isNutritiousFood` and `FoodNutritionRegistry.getFoodProperties`
  both fall back to `FoodNutritionRegistry.getNutrientTagScores`, so tag-only items no longer get
  silently skipped by the eating/tooltip pipeline.
- **`RecipeInheritanceStage` simplified**: the multi-nutrient qualifying-threshold filter
  (`MultiNutrientInheritance.filterQualifyingNutrients`, `NUTRIENTS_BELOW_THRESHOLD` failure
  reason) was removed — inherited nutrients that pass the earlier filtering stage are used
  directly, and unmatched keys are now reported as `REJECT_NO_MATCHING_KEYWORDS` rather than being
  split between low-confidence and no-match reasons.
- Mod description in `gradle.properties` no longer references a version-specific MarieLib
  changelog note (`(from v0.2.5-beta.5)`); still requires MarieLib 0.1.0-beta.2+.

### In Progress

- Example **source synergy** datapack entries added under
  `data/nourished/nourished/source_synergies/` (`hearty_meal`, `balanced_plate`, `breakfast`) —
  paired-food bonus definitions (`source_a`/`source_b`, time window, bonus value/modifier). Not
  yet loaded or consumed by any code; not active in this build.
